title: Capstone 2: Banking Ledger Balance Validator
subtitle: Financial Transaction Processing
description: Process account deposits and withdrawals across 2 interactive stages!
starter_code:
initial_balance = 1000.0
transactions = [200.0, -50.0, 300.0, -100.0]
# Stage 1: Compute final balance

challenges.title: Stage 1: Ledger Balance Reconciliation
challenges.description: Loop through <hlt>transactions</hlt>, add each to <hlt>balance</hlt>, and print the final reconciled balance.
challenges.starter_code:
initial_balance = 1000.0
transactions = [200.0, -50.0, 300.0, -100.0]
balance = initial_balance
# Stage 1: Transaction reconciliation
for tx in transactions:
    balance = balance + tx
print(balance)

challenges.title: Stage 2: Overdraft Safety Check
challenges.description: If <hlt>balance >= 0.0:</hlt> print <hlt>"Account In Good Standing"</hlt> else print <hlt>"Overdraft Warning"</hlt>.
